sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:13

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:13:1
items.html: She will not lose her illumination by becoming distant from the Emanator by one degree: That is to say, after the vessel of Hochma descended to the degree of Bina, for the reason that the light of Bina clothed in it, as above — behold, no break whatever was made by this between the Sefirot on account of the degree of Hochma lacking there, for the reason he states below: because no vacant space remained there within the degrees, since the vessel of Keter, in which the light of Hochma clothed, is found to fill the place of that lack. And this is what he says, “now that the light of Keter fills the place of that space, there is a way and a passage for the light of the Emanator to bestow in the root of Hochma” — that is to say, that the light of Hochma which is bestowed from the Emanator is bestowed in the vessel of Keter, and Keter is found filling the place of Hochma. And understand.
